reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the 'skip daily weekend occurrences, else move' rule that getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts already encodes is rewritten inline rather than factored into a shared helper.

duplication.why: The skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date mapping is copied from getUpcomingDates in the same file and the daily-weekend skip repeats getNextDate's rule, so the weekend policy now lives in a third place.

placement.why: The handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in the schedules server app, which is where handlers live, though the occurrence-to-final-day rule belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type and tests.

maintainability.why: Works as a compact pipeline, but a future change to weekend policy has to be applied to getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template and now this handler separately; the +/-2-day padding is an unexplained magic margin.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts reshapes getNextDate's daily-weekend skip loop (shared/schedules.ts) into an inline map-to-null + filter, alongside the skipWeekend ternary copied from getUpcomingDates.
